tickets.title: Organize estate settlement planning-side file
tickets.text: Organize a planning-side file separating probate assets, beneficiary assets, estate professionals, family decision points, and household planning impacts for Lydia Cloudpuddle as co-executor of Nora Velvetreed's estate. Include the traditional IRA at Velvet Acorn Custody, taxable brokerage account at Tin Sparrow Investments, condominium, and all related estate documentation.
tickets.evidence: Nora’s death left Lydia as co-executor, and Lydia asked Apricot Compass Advisory to organize a planning-side file separating probate assets, beneficiary assets, estate professionals, family decision points, and household planning impacts. The agreed follow-up is to organize that file by 2025-08-08.
